title: Character VFX and Props
description: CharacterVFX.json: buff-gated VFX overlays and spawnable props for one appearance.

$schema.description: This schema's URL, so editors validate as you type.

allVFX.description: Buff-gated VFX overlays, matched against the character's own buffs.

props.description: Spawnable visual objects: rings, thrown instances, planted world objects.

Vec3.description: [x, y, z]. Shorter arrays are padded with zeroes at load.

keyword.description: Buff keyword this overlay is gated on, read off the character wearing it.

stackThres.description: Stack the buff needs before the gate passes. Falling short of either threshold fails outright.

active.description: false hides the overlay while this entry is the selected one for its keyword.

vfxName.description: GameObject name inside any bundle under this appearance.

PropEntry.description: One prop declaration. Needs either 'folder' or 'prefab'; folder wins when both are set.

folder.description: PNG folder, resolved relative to THIS json, not the mod root. e.g. "props/knife".

prefab.description: GameObject name inside any bundle under this appearance. Ignored when 'folder' is set.

anchor.description: unit: rings the character. world: one instance placed in the scene. target: a ring around every ENEMY carrying this entry's keyword, sized by that enemy's own stack (takes no actions).

front.description: Unit anchor: parent to the front effect root rather than the back one. Also picks the default sorting order.

pos.description: unit: ring centre, local to the effect root. world: placement point. target: offset from the enemy's own position.

world.description: World anchor only: read 'pos' as absolute scene coordinates instead of caster-relative.

layer.description: Sorting layer name applied to every renderer.

order.description: Sorting order. 0 means the default for this anchor and side: 1000 in front, 998 behind. Characters sit near 1000, so a low value draws behind them.

scale.description: Uniform size multiplier. 0 or less reads as 1: an invisible prop is indistinguishable from a failed load.

count.description: Instance count when there is no 'keyword'. Clamped to maxCount and to 16. For a world anchor, only whether its single persistent instance exists at all; use 0 for plant-only.

maxCount.description: Ceiling on instances, itself clamped to 16. 0 means "no ceiling of my own" (i.e. 16), NOT zero instances.

parkRadius.description: Ring radius while parked, for a formation that hangs wider around an enemy than it orbits its caster. 0 means "same as radius".

speed.description: Degrees per second around the ring. 0 pins every slot. Negative reverses.

bob.description: Vertical bob amplitude. Needs bobPeriod set too.

bobPeriod.description: Bob period in seconds. 0 disables bobbing even if bob is set.

face.description: TARGET anchor only: point every instance at the unit it orbits. On a strike, use the action-level 'face' instead.

keyword.description: Buff keyword gating the prop. On a unit/world anchor it is read off the CASTER and the instance count becomes the buff's stack; on a target anchor it is read off each ENEMY. Omit for an always-on prop.

stackThres.description: Stack the buff needs before the gate passes.

parkUntil.description: How long a parked instance stays parked. round also snaps every parked slot home at the next round start.

actions.description: strike and plant behaviours. Rejected outright on a target-anchored entry.

then.description: A target ring follows its keyword, not the motion clock, so an action on one would be silently ignored.

PropAction.description: A strike moves ring instances to a target; a plant spawns a standalone world instance and forgets it.

do.description: Anything other than "plant" is treated as a strike.

motion.description: A MOTION_DETAIL name, the same string your S1.json / S2.json file is named after. An unknown name logs a warning at load and never fires.

coin.description: Which coin of that motion. -1 matches any.

slot.description: Strike only. "next" hands the i-th matching action the i-th slot, "all" moves every slot, or a 0-based index. Anything else is rejected at load.

start.description: Fraction of the motion at which it starts moving out.

arrive.description: Fraction at which it reaches its target. MUST equal the coin's GiveDamage phase start, or the hit and the prop disagree.

returnAt.description: Fraction at which it is home again. Negative means consumed on arrival instead of returning.

at.description: Plant only: fraction at which the instance is placed.

to.description: enemy: the first target. enemies: one target per slot, dealt round-robin. group: the average position of every target. center: midpoint of caster and first target. self: the caster. slot: the prop's own ring position (a recall, which also un-parks it).

offset.description: World-space offset added to the target point.

from.description: Where the strike launches from. "slot" is its own ring position, or for a parked prop wherever it is standing.

fromOffset.description: World-space offset on the launch point.

pos.description: Plant only: offset from the 'to' anchor, or an absolute position when the entry has "world": true.

ease.description: Case-insensitive. Anything unrecognized, including omitting it, is linear. These four only, not the DOTween list.

arc.description: World units the flight path bows. Zero at both ends, peaks mid-flight. Not applied to a wind-up draw-back.

windUp.description: World units drawn back away from the target before the throw.

windUpTime.description: How much of the outbound window the draw-back takes. Ignored when windUp is 0.

face.description: Rotate the instance to lead along its travel. Ignored if this action sets 'spin'. On a "ring" park it keeps re-aiming at the park point.

spin.description: Degrees per second of self-rotation while this action runs, overriding the entry's ambient spin. Beats 'face'.

consume.description: What a consumed instance does afterwards. Only applies when returnAt is negative. "gate" keeps it gone until the gate's count changes; on a fixed-count entry that is the rest of the battle.

park.description: Strike only. Ends by leaving the instance where it landed, outliving the motion. ring: keeps orbiting the park point. hold: frozen at the angle it arrived wearing. stack: every parked slot on the point itself. Cannot be combined with returnAt.

rounds.description: Plant only: how many rounds the placed instance survives. 0 or less means until the battle ends.

then.description: park and returnAt are two different endings; setting both is rejected at load.
